title: CDC Vaccine Policy Recommendations Grind to a Halt Under Health Secretary Kennedy
detail: A year after Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. moved to overhaul the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP), the panel's decision-making has stalled entirely: a federal judge blocked the HHS vaccine-schedule overhaul in March 2026, ruling Kennedy's replacement of committee members did not follow legal procedure, and ACIP has not met since. Proposed downgrades of COVID-19, influenza, hepatitis B and rotavirus vaccines to 'shared clinical decision-making' status remain paused, and federal vaccine schedules have reverted to those in place before the January 2026 memo, leaving providers and states without updated guidance for the 2026-2027 season.

media.caption: ACIP has not met since a federal judge blocked HHS's vaccine-schedule overhaul in March 2026

title: UN High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Preparedness Ends Without Consensus Declaration
detail: The Second UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response convened in New York six years after COVID-19 forced the Assembly's first-ever virtual session, but member states failed to reach consensus on a political declaration. General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman said members would 'consider the document in future' rather than adopt it immediately, after the EU objected to weak financing-accountability language, Germany pushed for stronger prevention commitments, and the U.S. — which withdrew from WHO in 2025 — opposed references to 'divisive ideologies' and a separate pathogen-sharing arrangement. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged delegates to 'get PABS done as soon as possible,' warning that further delay 'costs all countries daily when the next pandemic arrives.'
confidenceReason: WHO's press release frames the meeting as a renewal of commitment; independent wire reporting indicates the political declaration itself was not adopted due to EU/Germany/US objections.

media.caption: World leaders convene at the UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response
